title: Maureen Conway (VP, The Aspen Institute) — 'a must read for anyone trying to understand why our economy is so unsatisfying to so many people'
summary: The Aspen Institute vice president, whose own essay ran alongside Eric's in the Business & Society Program's weekly Navigator, calls the book amazing and frames it as the explanation for a broadly felt dissatisfaction with the economy.
blockquote: And an honor to be included alongside an essay from Eric Ries whose amazing book "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad ... And How Great Companies Stay Great" is a must read for anyone trying to understand why our economy is so unsatisfying to so many people.
